static_selection: first 30 rows in original source order, matching the static paper experiment
profile_assignment: Building-contained source users are static. Among remaining users, seeded ID ranking selects exactly 10 intermittent and 10 continuous users; others are static.
bounds_policy: Preserve existing bounds except sides excluding source coordinates; extend those sides 5 m past the outermost source point.
channel_model: Per-user legacy-static channel anchor plus the existing deterministic geometric model increments.
user_identity: Persistent (Scenario,RX_ID); source ID, X/Y/Z at t=0, request and label preserved.
time_origin: t=0 preserves the original static positions, requests and channel values.
interval_semantics: Frame t is an instantaneous sample at integer second t; movement fields describe (t-1,t]. Frame 0 has zero distance/speed. This is not a one-second averaged network measurement.
movement_model: Original 10 s correlated-random-walk segments, each subdivided into 10 straight constant-speed one-second segments. No new RNG draws or changed pause windows.
sampling_method: Piecewise linear XYZ interpolation on the exported original 10 s path, rounded to 6 decimals. Exact original anchors retained. Step and cumulative distances recomputed from delivered coordinates.
data_provenance: Derived simulation input; added samples are not independently observed or measured data.

channel_anchor.cqi_formula: round(1 + ((clamp(SNR_anchor,-10,30) + 10) / 40) * 14), Python round, matching upstream function
channel_anchor.signal_precision: Geometric LOS/path loss evaluated at each exported position; raw signal to 6 decimals, then Decimal per-user static offsets; no temporal channel interpolation.
channel_anchor.los_semantics: LOS at t0 and for stationary users is the original static LOS; at later nonstationary-profile frames it is current geometry LOS. raw_model_los always records current geometry, and exported_los_origin identifies provenance. Anchored SNR is not claimed to be a fresh uncalibrated path-loss prediction from exported LOS.
channel_anchor.dynamic_state_allocation: No allocation/admission/classification chosen or changed by this dataset generator.

limitations: Higher sampling density preserves existing paths; it does not add independent motion realism or measured high-frequency fading.
Original 10 s heading changes and movement/pause schedules are retained.
Original static channel offsets are retained, including north source/model discrepancies.
Four source users inside building footprints remain stationary; roads and shoreline walkability are not modeled.
These files contain mobility and modeled channels, not newly run allocation, throughput, fairness, or control outcomes.
Existing runners contain 10 s / 31-frame assumptions and need a separate scheduling update before using this input for completion-triggered control.
